title: Development of a Ti30Hf20Nb20Ta10V10Mo7W3 refractory high entropy alloy with excellent mechanical properties and wear resistance
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting with high-purity (≥ 99.95 wt%) metals in a water-cooled copper crucible under Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere, flipped and re-melted at least eight times for chemical homogeneity.
